title: Opening: names, birth date and neighborhood
summary: Russell opens the 1961 interview; Christophe gives his name, birth in New Orleans in 1912 and lifelong home in the Garden District.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: I'll make a note on here that this is August the 1st, 1961, and we're interviewing Mr. Christoff up at your home is 34, 25. 25. Loyal. And Ralph Collins is also here. This is Bill Russell. Do you want to give your full name, Mr. Christoff, your first name, any middle name?
Well, the middle name would be Eugene. Howell Eugene Christoff. Howell Eugene Christoff.
Howell Eugene Christoff. Do you mind telling us when you were born and what part of town?
I was born 1912, 4th of July, New Orleans, Louisiana.
What part of town did you come to?
Garden District. Been up here all my life.
That up in this section all my life?
In this section all my life.
